properties.descriptionHtml:
Note: Please refer to the following before installing the solution:

• Review the solution Release Notes

• There may be known issues pertaining to this Solution, please refer to them before installing.

The GitGuardian solution for Microsoft Sentinel ingests GitGuardian workspace audit logs and secret incidents through the Codeless Connector Framework (CCF). It provides visibility into administrative activity and exposed-secret remediation, including incident lifecycle, severity, validity, risk, assignment, detector, tags, exposure, ticket, and occurrence details.

Underlying Microsoft Technologies used:

This solution takes a dependency on technologies that might be in Preview or result in additional ingestion or operational costs:

  1. Codeless Connector Framework (CCF)

  2. Log Ingestion API

  3. Data Collection Rules (DCR)

Data Connectors: 1
